at + clock time: at seven, at noon|on + day/date: on Monday, on May 1st|in + month/season/year: in July, in summer|in the morning, at night, fixed collocations|at the weekend / on weekdays differ between British and American usage
I get up at seven every day.

# title: I get up _____ seven every day.
column4: 考查at + point in time; on + day and date; in + month, season, year。此处应为 at。句意:我每天七点起床。
